name: Google Drive
description: Integrate with Google Drive to search, read, and manage files. Supports Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and other formats.
author: Anthropic

requiredEnv.name: GDRIVE_CLIENT_ID
requiredEnv.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console

requiredEnv.name: GDRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for files in Google Drive

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from Google Drive
